Nina (CS): Heads-up: BlueOak Capital asks for a short APAC QPS lift for a partner webinar next Tue. They expect a burst to ~250 QPS for ~2.5 hours. Renewal rep marked this as high priority.
Raj (SE): Which region/endpoints/models and source IPs? We'll need org id + signed approval before changing rules.
Nina (CS): Details from customer: region ap-northeast-1 (Tokyo). Endpoints: /v1/generate (gpt-redwood-8k) and /v1/embeddings. Current org QPS=50, requested peak=250. Window: 2024-12-10T11:00:00+09:00 to 2024-12-10T13:30:00+09:00. CIDRs provided: 3.115.12.0/22, 52.68.0.0/16. Org: blueoak-prod. They uploaded a signed addendum to support.
Sofia (NetOps): We can add those CIDRs to the APAC edge allowlist and create a timebound policy. Will require ticket verification. Plan: apply temp rule, set auto-revoke + safety fallback at 110 QPS, and run canary. ETA ~25m after approval.
Clara (Support): Opening ticket for audit and attaching the signed doc now: https://support.redwood.ai/tickets/89377. Adding rollback checklist and contact for the customer.
Raj (SE): Suggest model override to limit compute: set /v1/generate -> gpt-redwood-8k:reduced-batch and enable session KV caching. Also add an eval monitor to watch for quality regressions. Proposed patch to ops:
```
org=blueoak-prod; region=ap-northeast-1; qps=250; window=2024-12-10T11:00:00+09:00/2024-12-10T13:30:00+09:00; allowlist=["3.115.12.0/22","52.68.0.0/16"]; model_override=/v1/generate->gpt-redwood-8k:reduced-batch; auto_revoke=true
```
Sofia (NetOps): Received. I'll apply temporary policy with auto-revoke at 2024-12-10T13:35:00+09:00 and fallback throttle at 110 QPS. Will post canary results.
ops-bot: Change request created: #CR-10012  temp-qps-blueoak-ap-northeast-1 assigned to Sofia.
Sofia (NetOps): Change applied: edge allowlist updated, routing policy set, temp QPS=250 live, fallback=110 QPS. Canary checks OK (200). Auto-revoke scheduled.
Ben (Billing): Quick cost estimate for finance ops: approx USD 380 incremental for the 2.5h burst (GPU + egress). I'll confirm precise after metrics.
Clara (Support): Uploaded signed addendum and rollback notes to ticket 89377. Ticket updated with audit trail.
Nina (CS): I'll flag renewals team and attach ticket. Customer will run a dress rehearsal tomorrow and report any anomalies.
Raj (SE): I'll monitor latency, error rates, and eval drift during the window. Will escalate if errors >1.5% or p95 increases significantly.
ops-bot: Change request #CR-10012 status=applied auto-revoke=scheduled.
Nina (CS): Post-demo update: rehearsal went smoothly, live event OK, customer said the change helped confidence for renewal. Please add final cost to ticket for the renewal package. :tada:
